Kerala ministers attend two-day strategic leadership retreat at IIM Kozhikode

Ministers of Kerala attended a two-day strategic leadership retreat at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Kozhikode. The workshop, inaugurated by Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan, focused on discussions led by IIM-K faculty and international experts. Topics covered included artificial intelligence, climate resilience, public health, ageing, employment, higher education, and fiscal matters.
